notes: Presets for 'Gerar cortes' (automatic Shorts/Reels). Edit this file to follow platform changes; Lingmo Studio reads it at start.
Lookup order: $LINGMO_STUDIO_PLATFORMS, ~/.local/share/lingmo-studio/platforms.json, /usr/share/lingmo-studio/platforms.json, the copy built into the app.
maxSeconds = hard upload/post limit of the format; recommended = editable default range used to pick highlights (not a platform rule).
safeArea = share of the frame (0..1) covered by the platform's interface on each side; captions and key content stay inside.
Limits come from each platform's help center / creative specs as of the 'updated' date (see 'source' per entry). Platforms change them often: verify before relying on a number.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.source: TikTok Help Center 'Uploading videos' (up to 10 min recorded/uploaded in app; 60 min from the web uploader) and TikTok Ads 'Safe zone' spec (right action bar, bottom caption area). Recommended 21-60 s: TikTok Creative Center best practices.

platforms.name: Instagram Reels
platforms.source: Instagram Help Center: Reels up to 3 minutes (since Jan 2025). Safe area: Meta Business Help 'Reels ads safe zones' (keep ~14% top, ~35% bottom, 6% sides free). Recommended range: Meta creative best practices (short, hook in the first 3 s).

platforms.name: YouTube Shorts
platforms.source: YouTube Help 'Upload YouTube Shorts': square or vertical videos up to 3 minutes (since Oct 2024). Safe area: YouTube Shorts overlay (title/channel at the bottom, actions on the right).

platforms.name: Facebook Reels
platforms.source: Facebook Help Center 'Create a reel' (Reels feed: up to 90 s). Meta (2025) merged Facebook videos into Reels; longer uploads post as video, not in the Reels feed. Safe area: Meta 'Reels ads safe zones'.

platforms.name: Kwai
platforms.source: Kwai creator help (in-app camera up to 60 s; uploads from the gallery up to 10 min, depending on the account). Kwai for Business ad specs: 9:16, 1080x1920. Safe area assumed like TikTok (same interface layout).

platforms.name: LinkedIn 1:1
platforms.source: LinkedIn Help 'Share videos on LinkedIn': up to 10 min (15 min from desktop), aspect 1:2.4 to 2.4:1. LinkedIn Marketing Solutions video ad specs: 1:1 1080x1080; best results 30-90 s.

platforms.name: LinkedIn 4:5
platforms.source: LinkedIn Marketing Solutions video ad specs: vertical 4:5 1080x1350 for the mobile feed; same length limits as 1:1.

platforms.name: X
platforms.source: X Help 'How to share and watch videos': up to 2 min 20 s (140 s) without X Premium; 1:2.39 to 2.39:1, vertical 9:16 shows full screen in the immersive player.

platforms.name: Stories (Instagram e WhatsApp)
platforms.source: Instagram Help 'Stories': each story segment up to 60 s. WhatsApp Help 'How to use Status': videos up to 60 s per update (since 2024). Safe area: Meta 'Stories ads safe zones' (14% top, 20% bottom).
